roles.name: Consulting and Business Development Lead, Europe & Overseas

tasks.name: Governance and decision-making setup
tasks.note: Setup is 2 weeks. Governance coverage extends through adaptive-11 (cutover and go-live readiness).

tasks.name: Current-state diagnostic
tasks.note: Expanded from 2 to 4 weeks to reflect 25-country, 75-ERP-instance complexity and realistic field access time.

tasks.name: Process and operating model assessment (pilot)
tasks.note: Expanded from 2 to 3 weeks — pilot scope only, covers Cash Application and Collections processes.

tasks.name: Future-state OTC design (pilot)
tasks.note: Pilot scope only — Cash Application and Collections. Enterprise future-state design is a separate later activity.

tasks.name: Business requirements and design authority (pilot)
tasks.note: Pilot-only BRD. Expanded from 2 to 4 weeks — covers Cash Application + Collections for 1 pilot country. Enterprise BRD for all countries is a separate later activity.

tasks.name: Change impact and stakeholder alignment
tasks.note: Starts during process assessment (W7). 12-week active delivery. Coverage extends through adaptive-11.

tasks.name: Testing coordination and business validation
tasks.note: Starts immediately after pilot readiness (W17). Runs throughout pilot implementations, ending when Collections Pilot completes.

tasks.name: Scale-up preparation and roadmap
tasks.note: Placed after pilot stabilization. Completes before enterprise design block starts.

tasks.name: Enterprise process and operating model assessment
tasks.note: Full 25-country scope. Builds on pilot learnings. Feeds enterprise future-state design.

tasks.name: Enterprise future-state OTC design
tasks.note: Starts 2 weeks before enterprise assessment completes (overlap with tail). Full OTC tower scope.

tasks.name: Enterprise BRD — Cash Application (all countries)
tasks.note: Starts 1 week before future-state design completes. Must finish before Cash Application Rollout begins.

tasks.name: Enterprise BRD — Collections (all countries)
tasks.note: Runs in parallel with Cash Application Rollout (Emagia team). Must complete before Collections Rollout starts. Adaptive core team is free during Emagia-led rollout.

tasks.name: Enterprise BRD — Disputes / Deductions / Reporting (all countries)
tasks.note: Runs in parallel with Collections Rollout (Emagia team). Must complete before Disputes Rollout starts.

tasks.name: Enterprise BRD — E-Invoicing (all countries)
tasks.note: Runs in parallel with Disputes Rollout (Emagia team). Must complete before E-Invoicing Rollout starts.

tasks.name: Enterprise BRD — Credit Management (all countries)
tasks.note: Runs in parallel with Disputes Rollout tail (Emagia team). Must complete before Credit Management Rollout starts.

tasks.name: Enterprise BRD — Order Management (all countries)
tasks.note: Runs in parallel with Credit Management Rollout (Emagia team). Must complete before Order Management Rollout starts.
